correctness.rationale: C=PASS: Specular geometry supplies primitive 2-cycle (length 1-2r, cosine 1) and primitive equilateral 3-cycle (length 1-sqrt(3)r, cosine sqrt(3)/2). Hessian of the exact ellipsoid gives principal curvatures 1/r and beta²/r. Scalar billiard Poincaré blocks have positive determinant-one matrix with trace 2+aL, a_perp=2 beta² c/r and a_planar=2/(r c). Thus exact acosh spectral radii yield opposite signs on (1,2/sqrt(3)), analytically for all such beta. Hölder potential minus t distance to each periodic orbit concentrates equilibrium Gibbs measures there; uniform hyperbolicity provides continuous 1D unstable line expansion functions, preserving signs at finite t. The standalone geometric finite-difference code is replayed successfully but is only corroborative, not an infinite proof.
